title: 1.4 Historical Issues and Contributors
description: Historical Issues and Contributors concepts and applications. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A textbook chapter compares the physics of the 1800s with that of the 1920s. Which pair of periods is being contrasted?
A scientist formulates three laws and explains planetary orbits with one force. Which contribution is being described?
options: Newtons laws of motion and universal gravitation
Faradays generator in this topic in the textbook
Joules heat-work relationship now in experiments
Curies discovery of radium still in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Newtons laws of motion and universal gravitation

questions.question: A scientist builds the first electric generator after earlier work with magnets and current. Who is being described?
A scientist connects heat with mechanical work and helps establish energy conservation. Who is being described?
A scientist discovers two radioactive elements and leads research in nuclear physics. Who is being described?
A scientist transforms ideas about space and time and also contributes to quantum theory. Who is being described?
A student claims Galileo showed that heavier bodies fall faster. Which correction matches the textbook?
options: He showed objects fall at the same rate regardless of mass
He showed gravity acts only on falling leaves for students
He showed mass has no meaning for students in the textbook
He showed falling objects repel each other in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: He showed objects fall at the same rate regardless of mass

questions.question: Which scientist is correctly matched with a field?
Which scientist is correctly matched with a contribution?
Which scientist is correctly matched with radioactivity research?
A historian writes about the scientific revolution of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. Which physicist is central to that story?
A museum exhibit shows an early generator and a magnet. Which scientist should the caption feature?
An exhibit explains why energy conservation became a guiding principle. Which scientist should be credited?
A lesson on radioactivity and nuclear structure begins with a pioneer. Which scientist should be named?
A lesson on relativity and quantum mechanics begins with a pioneer. Which scientist should be named?
Which pair of scientists both contributed to the development of quantum mechanics?
options: Einstein and the early quantum theorists
Newton and Galileo still in the textbook
Faraday and Joule as well in experiments
Curie and Snell in class in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Einstein and the early quantum theorists

questions.question: Which event best represents the transition from classical to modern physics?
options: Discoveries in the early twentieth century that modified older laws
The publication of Newtons laws now in the textbook of this subject
The construction of the first generator for students in experiments
The leaning-tower experiment as well in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Discoveries in the early twentieth century that modified older laws

questions.question: Which list contains only people described as contributors to physics in the unit?
options: Newton, Faraday, Joule, Curie and Einstein
Darwin, Linnaeus, Lamarck and Wallace here
Shakespeare, Dickens, Twain and Austen now
Moses, Aristotle, Plato and Socrates still
questions.correctAnswer: Newton, Faraday, Joule, Curie and Einstein
